moments.text: Infrared view with a large crosshair and red ring at centre over a grey, horizontally banded background; black masking blocks cover the edges.
The ring blinks off and a small box gate locks at the crosshair; inside it a faint light-grey speck slowly grows more distinct.
Two white flashes and dark frames as the sensor changes contrast; corner brackets show briefly and the red ring drops out, then returns.
The ring drops out for a second as the sensor zooms in; the speck returns larger and brighter inside the ring.
The object grows steadily inside the ring: two bright spots side by side by 34 s, a bright patch with darker marks by 50 s.
The object slips below the ring and slides lower right, a large white shape with dark curled marks, leaving at the bottom-right corner.
